mapper.sql: id, permission_name, permission_code, permission_type, parent_id, path, component, icon, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted, version
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_permission WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM sys_permission WHERE deleted = 0
AND permission_name LIKE concat('%', #{permissionName}, '%')
ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT p.* FROM sys_permission p LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sys_permission p LEFT JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission ( permission_name, permission_code, permission_type, parent_id, path, component, icon, sort_order, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted, version ) VALUES ( #{permissionName}, #{permissionCode}, #{permissionType}, #{parentId}, #{path}, #{component}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
